name: com.kevurugames/site
title: Kevuru Games
description: Search and read kevurugames.com (game development studio); send Kevuru Games an inquiry.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the website of Kevuru Games, a game development, game art, animation and outstaffing studio: services, hire pages, portfolio, case studies and projects (/our-latest-projects/) and blog articles. Use it to find what Kevuru Games offers, has built or has written about. Returns matching pages with snippets and URLs; read one in full with fetch, passing its id.

query.description: Free-text search query in English, e.g. "Unity mobile game development".

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Return the full text of one kevurugames.com page as markdown, by the id from search results (its canonical URL).

id.description: Page id from search: its canonical URL.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Return the full markdown of one kevurugames.com page by its canonical URL (e.g. https://kevurugames.com/our-latest-projects/). The same as fetch, as plain text.

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: Send a project inquiry to Kevuru Games on the user’s behalf: a request for a consultation, an estimate or a proposal for game development, game art, animation or outstaffing. It reaches the Kevuru Games team’s inbox and they reply by email to the address given. Use it only when the user asked to contact Kevuru Games, with the user’s own name and email address — never invent them — and show the user the text before sending. Sending means the user agrees to the Privacy Policy: https://kevurugames.com/privacy-policy/

email.description: The user’s real email address. Kevuru Games replies to it.

message.description: What the user needs: the task, the business context, timing, any constraints.
